Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> tarantulus wrote:
> does the direct "Go to topor" wounding action count as damage for the purpose of playing "prevent damage" cards?
>
> I say not, but some of my fellow players disagree...
>
You cannot prevent damage from a non-damage dealing strike.
Damage dealing strikes either involve strength (Slam) or a fixed number (Aid from Bats). "Strike: send the opposing minion to torpor" is not preventable. The only way to avoid going to torpor is with a Strike: Combat ends or a strike: dodge.
